references.text: Describes the manna more closely as white and tasting like honey cakes, elaborating on what the 'fine, flaky' substance was
Provides further description of the manna, including its appearance resembling bdellium and how it was gathered after the dew had settled
Moses reminds the people how God gave them manna in the wilderness to humble them and test them
The psalm describes how God rained down manna for them and gave them grain from heaven
Refers to God satisfying the people with bread from heaven
Nehemiah recalls that God gave bread from heaven to the people in the wilderness
Jesus refers to the manna that their fathers ate in the wilderness and calls himself the true bread from heaven
Jesus contrasts the manna in the wilderness with himself as the living bread from heaven
Revelation mentions the hidden manna as a promise to the one who overcomes
Paul refers to the manna as spiritual food that their fathers ate
